body: T4 - STREAK VISUALIZATION SPEC. Current: no streak feature exists. This is a spec for a future component. WHAT STREAK TRACKS: consecutive exams where Kai scores above his previous attempt. Not calendar days - performance-relative streak. WHY: variable reward and engagement principle (Sagvolden 2005). COMPONENT: streak-badge shown in hero section of dashboard. Appears after 2+ consecutive improving scores. VISUAL: horizontal pill badge. Detroit Red #C8102E background. White text. Content: fire emoji + N-exam streak. Example: fire N-exam streak. Width: auto. Height: 28px. Border radius: 14px. Font: system-ui 13px 700. STATES: no streak (hidden), streak 2 (visible, red), streak 5+ (animated border shimmer effect). SHIMMER: @keyframes streakShimmer 2s infinite. Border rotates through Pistons palette: red blue navy. PLACEMENT: right side of hero section, inline with grade display. REDUCED MOTION: static badge only, no shimmer. THRESHOLD: streak breaks if any exam score is below previous. Badge disappears with 400ms fade-out. WHY PERFORMANCE STREAK NOT CALENDAR STREAK: Calendar streaks punish Kai for not studying every day. Performance streaks celebrate improvement. Kai misses a day, streak resets unnecessarily. Performance streak resets only on regression.
